title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode3 His Words

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: A few years earlier
Rehearsal Area

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew... We're moving much more in sync now.

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Yeah, we've totally got this formation down!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, let's start putting polish on the dance itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Is everything okay?
You don't look too good. Are you not feeling well?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: Oh, no... It's not that...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: The thing is... I just overheard our manager talking on the phone and...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: Oh, what did you hear?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: You know the show “Go Wild & Crazy!”...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that daytime show that's run practically forever?

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Just once, I wanna go on!
I mean, there's no one in Japan who hasn't heard of it!

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Member A
rows.Line: ASRUN was asked to start appearing as regulars, but Mr. Hiiragi turned them down.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (He turned down an offer like that...?!)

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Wh-Why...?!
People all over Japan watch “Go Wild & Crazy!”

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line:
Right?
Appearing as regulars would give us a huge boost in terms of name recognition...

rows.Speaker: ASRUN Members
rows.Line: It'd be a chance for us to start spreading hope to people all across Japan like the other top idol groups...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Would you mind stopping by the office after you're finished with practice, Haruka? Mr. Hiiragi would like a word with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, understood.
Office
Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Hello. Sorry, I know this is sudden, but I received an offer asking for you and you alone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just me?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That's right. You're being asked to participate in a performance battle, where you and a few other idols will compete to see who can come up with the best dance routine on the spot.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: This is a chance to showcase not just yourself, but the technical prowess of ASRUN as a whole. Keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...!
Right!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I'll send the details over to your manager.
That's all from me.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: E-Excuse me...!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
...?
What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's a question I'd like to ask.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is it true that you turned down an offer involving us becoming regulars on “Go Wild & Crazy!”?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Honestly...
I'll need to remind your manager not to take calls where people can hear him.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: W-Wait, so...!

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: It's all true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I asked why?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're trying to become idols who can spread hope to people all across Japan. I can't figure out any reason to...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That very dream is why I turned them down.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Why has ASRUN been able to become as popular as it has?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Because it's never lost sight of what makes it special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What makes us special...?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes. I believe that idols need to feel unique in some way.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: In other words, ASRUN must offer something that other idols or artists can't hope to emulate. That's what sets your group apart from them.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Your fans will be drawn to that, and they'll be willing to cheer at the top of their lungs for you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Cheer...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Yes, in support of your dream.
To make it come true together.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: They're absolutely crucial.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hearing our fans cheer us on and feel encouraged by what we do has been huge in terms of us getting this far...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Some have even reached out to their friends and family and invited them to cheer us on together...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We started out selling CDs by hand at shopping malls, and now look how far we've come.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Their voices, their support...
They kept driving ASRUN forward.)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Yes, it's important to use high-profile programs to increase your name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: But establishing a loyal fan base takes absolute priority. Finding those who will cheer at the top of their lungs for you is beyond important.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the top of their lungs...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What do you think it is that makes ASRUN special, Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(What makes us special...
What separates us from everyone else in our fans' minds?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our performances?

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Correct.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Your brilliant smiles, your compelling dances, the way your voices ring out towards the back... They inspire hope in everyone watching.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That's the kind of idol group ASRUN is.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: That being said, I didn't make my decision regarding “Go Wild & Crazy!” lightly. I just felt that now wasn't the right time yet.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: People need to understand what ASRUN is actually about. Until that image is solidified in the public eye...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: I want to place what makes ASRUN special at the forefront, even if it means we do things small for a while.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Because I believe that's the quickest way for your group to realize its dream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (All I'd been thinking about until now was “spreading hope to lots of people.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I never thought about the best way to actually reach that goal.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Mr. Hiiragi's looking that far ahead...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I really appreciate you telling me all this.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
More importantly, I have high expectations for your next show.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Go show everyone what makes ASRUN special. That's going to be your ticket to the future.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We will!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Show everyone what makes us special...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... He always accepted offers that would place what made ASRUN special at the forefront.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's what we've been missing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What is it that makes MORE MORE JUMP! special?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been doing our best to put on good performances, but we can't really match the groups that have professional choreographers and trainers working with them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for our talking skills... There's Airi, of course, and Minori also has a natural talent for making others smile and laugh. Still, I'm not sure that's what makes us special.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I know there's something there. I just can't quite put it into words.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
This is really frustrating...
How do I find the right words for what I'm feeling?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to ask the others about this, but it's already pretty late. I should probably wait until tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'll try popping over for a little bit to ask them.
